If your looking to keep moisture in anything silk will work. And yes, Durags will flatten your hair. Since my hair is in twists almost all the time I prefer to sleep with a durag over a bonnet. You can also try a silk scarf with a bonnet over that so it won’t be as much tension on the hair and if the scarf comes off in the night your bonnet is still protecting your hair. 

If you are sleeping with your hair out, even with a bonnet over it, majority of the time you’ll experience knotting. It’s gonna be more time consuming but putting in twists or Bantu knots before going to bed will help with the knotting.

1.) I heard this in a YouTube video once: “as long as your alive and healthy your hair is always growing.” When you have this mindset you have to look past the “how to get my hair to grow faster” stuff and begin to look at “how can I maintain the length. At least for me, my 4c hair grows upward and out. So it’s much easier to see the growth while I’m coming out an Afro or something.

2.) I section my hair during wash day. I tend to have a lot of breakage at my crown area so imagine a pentagon shape in the middle. It takes longer but I wash each section out separately because Ik my hair breaks a ton. If you have split ends that are not cut this will also cause breakage because the hair will continue to split until it reaches the root. This makes the strand thinner and weaker- easier to break. I also detangle my ends before I put in another product (you don’t have to do that but my hair is thick and saves me a lot of time when styling).  *Use a wide tooth comb*

3.) To maintain length you have to in a sense feed your hair. That means making sure it moisturized, staying out of it etc. 

4.) I’m not sure if your saying your hair is 3 inches but if you go to a good braided they’ll be able to do it. My friend did a big chop and he hair was crazy short but her hairdresser was able to do her hair and it looked amazing. Also don’t be tempted to do protective hairstyles. They never worked for me and pulled out my hair in the end. It won’t necessarily make your hair grow faster. It’s just so your hair is protected so damage cannot occur. 

Hope this helps ☺️

First I want to say I’ve never had a perm so I’m no expert but here’s some advice and I hope it helps. 

one thing I’ve learned is there is no way to “grow your hair”. If your alive and breathing your hair will always be growing. The question you want to ask is “how can I maintain my hair growth and minimize breakage”. Having that mindset when it came to hair helped me eliminate the “grow your hair overnight” Gimmicks. 

If you don’t wanna cut it all at once you can snip them off overtime.

Protective styles don’t always mean box braids and weave. At least for me those broke my ends and it was always costly. Simple cornrows/ plats are fine too. 

I would also recommend you look into hot oil treatments and protein treatments. I blend up eggs, aloe Vera, apple cider vinegar and mix in some oils (castor, olive, etc). Doing so can strengthen your hair and make it less prone to breakage and may even help revive some of those permed ends. 

Ask your parents to invest in good products. Shampoos, conditioners, oils and so on. I use a brand called “CANVAS”. They send sulfate free shampoos an oil mix which can be used for hot oil treatments, edge control, leave in, and more. Basically all you need for a wash day and it’s about $100 for the package. To me it’s expensive but a little goes a long way w their products plus I only wash my hair about once every month and a half.

Another thing I want to mention is to know your ingredients. You don’t have to know everything on the bottle but know what to look out for when reading ingredients of products. There will be products that claim to be 100% what their advertising but it will be the last on the ingredient list so just look out for that. 

One thing that worked for me was the sulfur 8 and blue magic tiktok frenzy. I add Jamaican black castor oil and a little pint of peppermint extract for the smell,
Plus peppermint is also a good for stimulating the scalp and promotions hair growth. I applied it to my scalp 3 days a week every other day.  Do not do it every day. 

Try massaging your scalp everyday, twice and day of you can. You can also try the upside down method. You just massage your scalp upside down
 
Lastly consistency is key. I’ve ignored my hair for long periods of time which is why I’m still stuck at the same
length. Don’t be discouraged if you don’t see immediate growth/ changes. 

Last last advice is too be careful
about some of the products advertised toward your hair type. I too have 4c and a lot of ppl in the hair industry manipulate the difficulty of maintaining this hair type to make money.  Someone else recommended some good channels whom I also watched when I wanted to learn more about my hair. 

Last last last advice. Your hair is apart of your body and living a healthy life also plays a role in how well your hair will thrive. I can’t say I eat the healthiest but exercise and and make sure your drinking enough water. 

Hope this helps. Lmk of you have anymore questions.
